newsitem.title: USA: US spot MTBE lower on thin trade.
newsitem.headline: US spot MTBE lower on thin trade.

text.p: U.S. spot MTBE prices were assessed slightly lower this week on a lack of demand ahead of the long holiday weekend, players said.
"It's all sellers. There are no bids," said one New York Harbor broker, adding that most of the trade for November product was over.
On the Gulf Coast, Houston MTBE was talked between 85.00 cents and 85.50 cents. On Monday deals were done for 85.25 cents and 85.50 cents for November.
In New York Harbor, prices were notional since many players had left early for the Thanksgiving holiday.
NYMEX is closed Thursday and Friday.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
